# CapsuleProcessStartConfig

An automation action (`$type` is `capsule`) that starts a capsule run. `version` names the capsule and the version of it to start, and is required.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests and responses. In a request it is called `CapsuleProcessStartConfigInput`.

## In a request

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vfsMounts` | [`CapsuleVirtualFileSystemMountInput`](capsule-virtual-file-system-mount.md#in-a-request)`[]` |  | Virtual file system mounts for the run. A non-empty list replaces the capsule's own; an empty list keeps them. |
| `secretMounts` | [`CapsuleSecretMountInput`](capsule-secret-mount.md#in-a-request)`[]` |  | Secret mounts for the run. A non-empty list replaces the capsule's own; an empty list keeps them. |
| `version` | [`VersionReference`](version-reference.md)`\| null` |  | The app, interaction or capsule to start, and the version of it. Required for those three; left out for `codepipeline` (named by `name`) and `interaction-message` (which names a run). |

```json
{
  "vfsMounts": [
    {
      "vfsId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
      "vfsNamespaceId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
      "mountName": "..."
    }
  ],
  "secretMounts": [
    {
      "secretName": "...",
      "mountName": "..."
    }
  ],
  "version": {
    "id": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
    "version": 0
  }
}
```
